schema:name: Semantic Web Companion
schema:description: Semantic Web Companion is a modern, extensible tool for exploring, visualizing, and working with structured data on the web. It is a comprehensive refactor and evolution of the Openlink Structured Data Sniffer (OSDS), providing a React-based, user-friendly interface and advanced features for the semantic web community.
schema:featureList: Detects and visualizes Microdata, JSON-LD, Turtle, RDFa, RDF/XML, POSH, JSON, and CSV
Interactive graph and table views (React Flow)
Extensible AI agent and LLM integration
Refactored from Openlink Structured Data Sniffer (OSDS)
